watchlist.thesis: No material change since run #20. ARQQ remains a story stock riding a genuine quantum-safe-encryption policy tailwind (Executive Order 14412) and real commercial demonstrations (the Es'hailSat satellite demo), but none of the quiet-accumulation tells are present. Insiders have shown zero open-market cash buying for months — 0 insider buys vs. 8 insider sellers over the trailing 12 months, reconfirmed via MarketBeat as of September 14, 2026 — and institutional flows remain dominated by passive index/ETF trackers; the only new SEC filing since run #20 (a September 10 Schedule 13G/A from existing holder Notion Capital III LP) is a routine ownership amendment, not evidence of fresh discretionary buying. The stock closed Friday, September 11, 2026 at a confirmed $20.05 (-2.58% on the day), down 13.49% over the trailing month versus the August 7, 2026 close of $22.90. Monday pre-market indications (market not yet open as of this ~9:24am ET check) show further softness to roughly $19.81, about -1.2% versus Friday's close, on very thin pre-market volume — a continuation of the light-volume drift, not a breakout or capitulation event. Keeping score and status unchanged per playbook guidance: absence of fresh negative news is not grounds for a cut, but there is still no fresh evidence to justify raising the score.
watchlist.risks: Single-analyst coverage with an outlier $60 price target (roughly 203% implied upside from the ~$19.81 pre-market indication) that likely overstates near-term realism and could reverse sharply on any negative revision. High historical volatility (52-week range $11.52-$62.00). Persistent insider abstention from cash buying, combined with a 12-month insider-selling total of ~$2.44 million, remains a yellow flag for management's own read on valuation. Small float and thin average daily volume (~685,361 shares) make the stock prone to sharp single-day moves on low-quality news. Tiny revenue base (fiscal 2025 revenue ~$535K; fiscal 2026 executed contracts ~$1.2M) leaves the stock almost entirely dependent on policy-tailwind narrative rather than current fundamentals. No current-quarter institutional accumulation confirmed. Note: Monday pre-market price is an indication only — market has not yet opened as of this run's ~9:24am ET check, and pre-market prints on very thin volume can reverse once regular trading begins.

That requested deadline is today, and as of this check it has not been met with any substantive Commission action. Per process rules, FERC deadlines are not binding law, and the Commission may simply let the requested date pass without ruling — this is exactly what appears to be happening. This is unresolved, not a new catalyst in either direction, and per process rules the continued absence of a ruling is explicitly NOT a score-change trigger on its own.
